output.summary: The customer's statutory, notarized power of attorney for their 90-year-old father was refused twice at the Elm & 4th branch as "not on our form"; accepted on the third visit. Customer wants an explanation.
issues: Valid statutory power of attorney refused twice at branch
Staff inconsistent knowledge of POA policy
Customer had to cover father's bills from own account during delay
customer_requests: Explanation of why staff did not know bank's POA policy

financial_impact.evidence: I covered them from my own account in the meantime

harm_ongoing.evidence: On the third visit a different banker accepted it in five minutes. Dad's bills are fine

repeat_contact.evidence: The Elm & 4th branch refused to accept it twice
